sloka: तस्यारण्यस्य मध्ये तु सरो योजनमायतम् ।हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् ।। ७.७७.४ ॥
transliteration: tasyāraṇyasya madhye tu saro yojanamāyatam ।haṁsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṁ cakravākopaśobhitam ।। 7.77.4 ॥

translations.english: In the middle of that forest was a lake, a yojana in length, teeming with swans and karandava ducks, and graced by chakravaka birds.
